dashboard.description: Your next action and the activity around it, in one calm place.

landing.eyebrow: A better path for paddy straw
landing.title: Keep the straw in the loop.
landing.lede: ResidueLoop helps Punjab's farmers, buyers, donors, and local organisations turn crop residue into a useful resource—not smoke.
landing.art_caption: Value grows when every field has a next step.
landing.marquee: List it · Match it · Move it · Keep the air clearer ·
landing.process_title: From field to useful resource—without the detour through smoke.

list.title: List the straw
list.body: A farmer records a harvest and a nearby field. We keep the details clear and practical.

match.title: Make a useful match
match.body: Buyers can see available supply and arrange pooled pickup when the load is ready.

verify.title: Track what matters
verify.body: Field and pickup updates create a simple record for the people doing the work.

landing.roles_title: One shared problem. Useful roles for everyone who can move it forward.

farmer.title: Farmers
farmer.body: Turn a difficult residue decision into a visible sale and a clearer pickup plan.

buyer.title: Buyers
buyer.body: Find nearby, baled straw and follow each pickup from plan to weight.

donor.title: Donors
donor.body: Back local collection and see the support your contribution makes possible.

landing.impact_title: A small next step for every field can add up to a cleaner season.
landing.impact_body: ResidueLoop makes the handoffs visible: harvest, match, pickup, and support. It never promises an outcome it cannot verify.
landing.footer: A practical loop for paddy straw.
